hints.title: Single-Pass Attribute Inversion
hints.text: Invert every value of the sex attribute from m to f and vice versa without temporary intermediary tables.

hints.title: Case Conditional Toggle Expression
hints.text: Use a case expression returning f when sex = "m" and returning m otherwise within an update or select projection.

hints.title: Swap Attribute Blueprint
hints.text: update Salary set sex = case when sex = "m" then "f" else "m" end.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
UPDATE Salary
SET sex = CASE WHEN sex = 'm' THEN 'f' ELSE 'm' END;
```

variables: N: number of records in Salary table
complexity.notes: Direct in-place field mutation runs in linear scan time without extra table memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Two sequential updates without a temporary placeholder convert all values to the same sex.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single evaluation CASE avoids multi-pass state corruption.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Writing a single update statement with CASE or IF toggle without intermediate tables.

solutions.code:
UPDATE Salary
SET sex = CASE WHEN sex = 'm' THEN 'f' ELSE 'm' END;

UPDATE Salary
SET sex = CASE WHEN sex = 'm' THEN 'f' ELSE 'm' END;

import pandas as pd

def swap_salary(salary: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    salary['sex'] = salary['sex'].apply(lambda x: 'f' if x == 'm' else 'm')
    return salary
